headline: eClerx Services finalizes acquisition of RegEdge LLC
hook: eClerx expands US regulatory tech footprint

summary: eClerx Services has officially completed its acquisition of US-based regulatory technology firm RegEdge LLC. The acquisition is part of the company's broader strategy to enhance its digital transformation offerings for global clients.
